messages:
maya: Heads-up: new customer asked for an export flow that guarantees region-bound storage, cryptographic proof of exports, and an explicit legal-hold override. We need to agree on tiers, proof format, and delivery modes.
rachel: Keep the live path untouched. Build an async exporter that writes sealed archives + a proof file. That keeps perf risk low.
tom: From infra: feasible. We need an S3 onboarding template and a small IAM handshake. Also clarify whether we support writing to customer-owned buckets or only to our vault.
amira: Security wants per-batch signature (HSM), per-file sha256, and a Merkle root. Include key fingerprint and handshake timestamp in the proof.
legal-bot: Legal: customers asking for 6-7 year retention in some jurisdictions. We'll require an opt-in contract appendix and explicit residency clause. Also demand auditable legal-hold approvals.
maya: Draft proposal: default retention 12 months; enterprise appendix for up to 7 years. Proof artifact = signed JSON manifest + merkle_root + checksums. Delivery: push to customer bucket when BYOK + onboarding complete, otherwise to our escrow vault.
rachel: Implementation checklist: manifest schema, exporter job, bucket onboarding docs, admin UI for holds, keystore handshake changes. Estimate minimal prototype in 4 sprints if scoped to offline path.
tom: I'll create infra ticket and add bucket policy template. We also need monitoring for export success/failure and retry semantics.
amira: I'll draft sample manifest fields and map them to SOC2 control points.
legal-bot: I'll prepare contract language and a short FAQ for sales.
maya: Kicking off a 30m sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to lock decisions. Bring one concrete decision each.
